top_signals.title: DARPA developing hypersonic cruise missile to evade enemy air defenses
top_signals.summary: DARPA is developing a hypersonic cruise missile in response to the Pentagon's concerns that American missiles are vulnerable to enemy air defenses.

top_signals.title: Air Baltic Bonds Slump After Airline’s Debt-for-Equity Swap Plan
top_signals.summary: Bonds issued by Air Baltic Corp slumped further into deeply distressed levels after the ailing Latvian airline announced plans to swap much of its debt for equity as part of a restructuring plan.
